scope: Recheck the active zero-restart coordinator, authority, observer, mint and FIPS services and the inactive zero-restart site.
Require the authority to remain composite-ready, the coordinator queue to remain revision 0 with zero operations, and APP system time to remain within two seconds of its UTC RTC.
Require the exact installed site unit, site binary, release binding, loopback authority listener and absence of listeners on 8180, 80 and 443.
Start plebeian-friday-site.service once and verify it binds exactly 127.0.0.1:8180 with zero restarts.
Perform read-only GET probes of the root document, browser release pins, API configuration, state and validator status.
Preserve a create-once action receipt and final actual or stopped receipt. Stop only the site started by this action if acceptance fails.
acceptance: Site remains active with NRestarts=0 and listener exactly 127.0.0.1:8180.
No listener appears on 0.0.0.0, ::, ports 80 or 443; nginx stays inactive.
GET / returns the embedded application with the expected browser security headers.
GET /api/config reports FAKE_MONEY_ONLY, the pinned chain, threshold custody, both browser readiness flags true and recovery_only=false.
GET /api/browser-release-pins returns the pinned release manifest.
GET /api/state and GET /api/validators succeed without creating an operation.
The authority remains ready and the coordinator queue remains revision 0 with zero operations after the probes.
knownQualification: The genesis compatibility URL http://127.0.0.1:8180/test-mint is intentionally a non-operational legacy namespace in the installed Friday server and must return 404. The real Friday browser wallet talks to the separately pinned Cashu HTTPS identity. Therefore the obsolete service-activation-plan requirement that /test-mint proxy to the mint is not an acceptance criterion for this action.
securityEffects: The site becomes reachable only from APP loopback; it remains unavailable to the five remote team browsers.
The site process may read public chain state and exposes mutation routes only on loopback. No mutation route is probed.
The close trigger starts but the precondition requires an empty chain/application queue; no due auction exists.
No threshold signature, payment, fake-sat movement, credential creation, HTTPS, nginx, firewall, NTP configuration or public exposure is requested.
failurePolicy: Stop only plebeian-friday-site.service if this action started it, preserve all receipts and state, and do not retry automatically.
remainingBlockers: Remote five-user use requires separately authorized and verified HTTPS reverse-proxy exposure; the browser controller rejects non-HTTPS origins.
APP systemd-timesyncd remains unsynchronized; RTC agreement is a temporary fake-money window only and is not production-money readiness.
